desc: Identify the greedy feasibility reduction: exactly K pairs are feasible iff the K smallest and K largest mochi can be paired in order satisfying the size condition.
Implement and validate the F/D plus RMQ and per-query binary-search algorithm, including proof of feasibility monotonicity and indexing.
Produce edge-case tests covering duplicates, no feasible pairs, all feasible pairings, equality at twice the size, and short intervals.
